en.t: It has gotten a little cooler.

units.source_text: 七段说罢旋即站起来走了。

en.t: No sooner had the seventh-dan player said this than he stood up and left.

units.source_text: 他在走廊上把裙裤脱下，去厕所解完小手出来，竟把裙裤前后穿反了。

en.t: In the corridor he took off his hakama, went to the restroom to relieve himself, and when he came out he had somehow put the hakama on backward.
